 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 participant CPU as CPU(M)
 participant MEM as Mem control(S)
 participant DMAM as SIP DMA(M)
 participant DMAS as SIP DMA(S)

 rect rgb(240, 248, 255)
 note over CPU, DMAS: 1. CPU 配置 SIP 暫存器 (AHB)
 CPU->>DMAS: HADDR, HTRANS(NONSEQ), HWRITE (位址階段)
 CPU->>DMAS: HWDATA (Pkt 起始/終點位址, 長度) (資料階段)
 DMAS-->>CPU: HREADY = 1, HRESP = OKAY
 end

 rect rgb(255, 250, 240)
 note over DMAS: 2. SIP DMA 內部啟動逻辑
 end

 rect rgb(240, 255, 240)
 note over MEM, DMAM: 3. DMA 搬移資料至 Memory (AHB)
 DMAM->>MEM: HADDR, HTRANS(NONSEQ) (位址階段)
 MEM-->>DMAM: HREADY = 0 (Memory Wait State)
 MEM-->>DMAM: HREADY = 1, HRDATA/HWDATA (資料階段完成)
 end

 rect rgb(255, 240, 245)
 note over CPU, DMAS: 4. 中斷通報
 DMAS-->>CPU: IRQ (搬移完成中斷)
 end",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
